newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE IN WORLD SQUAD AGAINST ENGLAND CHAMPIONS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE IN WORLD SQUAD AGAINST ENGLAND CHAMPIONS.

text.p: Veteran Australian winger David Campese will make another farewell appearance in Britain after being named on Tuesday in a world squad to play England's club champions at Twickenham on May 24.
Campese, who has won an army of fans around the world through his thrilling individual play, retired from test rugby last year after winning 101 caps for Australia.
He is one of five Australians named in the 22-man squad which includes many of the world's leading players.
There are also five players each from New Zealand and South Africa, including their World Cup winning captain Francois Pienaar, now playing in England.
French centre Philippe Sella will lead the world side as he did last year when they beat last season's champions Leicester 40-31.
Their opponents will not be known until two or three weeks before the match, with Leicester, Wasps, Bath and Harlequins still strongly in contention for the championship.

Squad: Backs: K.Imaizumi (Japan), A.Joubert (SA), D.Knox (Aus), D.Campese (Aus), J.Kerwan (NZ), J.Roff (Aus), C.Williams (SA), P.Sella (Fra, capt), L.Arbizu (Arg), G.Bachop (NZ), G.Gregan (Aus), J.van der Westhuizen (SA).
Forwards: E.McKenzie (Aus), P.Noriega (Arg), M.Allen (NZ), J.Dalton (SA), J.M.Gonzales (Fra), O.Roumat (Fra), A.Benazzi (Fra), J.Joseph (NZ), F.Pienaar (SA), M.Jones (NZ).
